description: This file defines the NavigationModel class, which manages states, transitions, and their locations within a navigation graph, including event dispatching for changes.

classes.name: NavigationModel
classes.description: Manages navigation states, transitions, and their locations, with event notification capabilities.

classes.name: NavigationModel.Event
classes.description: Represents events related to insert, update, or delete operations on navigation elements.

methods.name: getStates
methods.description: Returns the list of all states in the navigation model.

methods.name: getTransitions
methods.description: Returns the list of all transitions in the navigation model.

methods.name: getStateToLocation
methods.description: Returns the mapping of states to their locations.

methods.name: getLocations
methods.description: Returns a collection of state-location entries.

methods.name: addState
methods.description: Adds a new state to the model and notifies listeners.

methods.name: removeState
methods.description: Removes a state and associated transitions, then notifies listeners.

methods.name: updateStates
methods.description: Ensures a state is included in the states list.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a transition and updates involved states.

methods.name: getActivities
methods.description: Returns a map of activity states keyed by class name.

methods.name: getMenus
methods.description: Returns a map of menu states keyed by XML resource name.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all states and transitions, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: getListeners
methods.description: Returns the event dispatcher for listeners.
